beginner.title: Get started with Bamboo
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Bamboo, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up safely
beginner.outcome: You can: create your account securely
beginner.practice: Set up and secure your account

beginner.title: Core use
beginner.outcome: You can: use Bamboo for its main purpose
beginner.practice: Complete one real transaction or task

intermediate.title: Get more value
intermediate.outcome: You can: use features most people miss
intermediate.practice: Try three features you've never used

intermediate.title: Resolve problems
intermediate.outcome: You can: handle issues and disputes
intermediate.practice: Find the support and dispute process

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Bamboo
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Bamboo distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Bamboo
expert.outcome: You can: use Bamboo's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Track and teach
expert.outcome: You can: track value and help others use it
expert.practice: Help one person get started with Bamboo

expert.title: Integrate Bamboo into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Bamboo with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Bamboo to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Bamboo well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Bamboo" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
